name: Cybergatinhos!
source:
You're a kitten (literally) who's just opened an internet cafe in the big city! Build relationships with your assistant Lionel or your regular customer Van and find out more about these two... cyberkittens!

[From [url=https://lenlen403.itch.io/cybergatinhos-cyberkittens]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是一隻小貓（真的就是貓），剛剛在大城市裡開了一家網咖！和助理Lionel或常客Van培養感情，進一步瞭解這兩隻網路小貓吧！

[來源：[url=https://lenlen403.itch.io/cybergatinhos-cyberkittens]Itch.io[/url]]
